name: Bootstrap Colors
description: Interactive color-scheme generator that writes a Material-Design-based palette into a Bootstrap Barrio (sub)theme's settings.
project_description: Bootstrap Colors adds an admin page (/bootstrap/colors) that builds an interactive, jQuery-based color-scheme generator using Google Material Design color concepts and the Colour Lovers palette gallery. A theme developer selects a primary base color and an accent base color (typed, chosen from a bundled Bootstrap color picker, from Material Design swatches, or from Colour Lovers palettes) and picks variations; the module's ColorForm submit handler then writes the selected shades into the ACTIVE theme's settings (the bootstrap_barrio_* keys, e.g. bootstrap_barrio_base_primary_color, body/background/heading colors) and enables bootstrap_barrio_enable_color, so a Bootstrap Barrio-based (sub)theme can be recolored without hand-editing SCSS. It ships no config/install or config/schema; the color values live in the theme's own settings object. Intended to be used together with the Bootstrap Barrio theme and the Bootstrap Library module (configured to use SASS-compiled files) so Bootstrap is recompiled with the chosen variables.
